name: Sovereign Inheritance
description: A HelixCorp-funded neural spectacle following Adaeze Vanthorpe-Kim, a Tier 4 corporate heir who uncovers a conspiracy threatening the entire Meridian 88 compact — and must choose between family loyalty and the city's survival. Players experience 14 hours of immersive corporate intrigue, seduction, and aerial combat across the Spire's upper decks. Widely considered the highest-budget neural-feed production of the 2180s, with a sensory fidelity benchmark that competitors spent a decade chasing.
cultural_impact: Set the commercial standard for neural-feed blockbusters and spawned the 'Spire-gaze' aesthetic trend in which Tier 2-3 consumers paid premium subscriptions just to experience Tier 5 environments vicariously.
story_hooks: A data courier discovers the leaked original screenplay and realizes the deleted scenes describe real events — atrocities that are still ongoing.
An actor who performed motion-capture for the film's antagonist has been quietly disappeared; their last message points to something buried in the film's sensory metadata.
A Shelf activist group is distributing a hacked version of the feed with subliminal counter-messaging embedded in the pleasure-response layers.
